body.text: I was honoured to receive the Dare to Care Leadership Award – Student Choice at Sheridan College's 2026 Student Leadership Awards.

When I arrived at Sheridan two years ago, my goal was simply to learn and connect with new people. Since then, I have had the opportunity to build communities, found the Women in Business and Technology Club, and collaborate with people who continually challenge me to grow. I am deeply grateful for this recognition.

body.text: I entered Sheridan College's Latin American Art Contest and won 2nd place in the 3D Visual Arts category. As a design student, submitting work to an art competition at an art school was a new step for me, and one I am glad I took.

My submission, Somewhere Between Peaks, is a 3D projection-mapping piece created in TouchDesigner. It explores Latin America as a connected whole, reflecting how culture, history and identity continue to link the Latino community across borders, even far from home. Through layered visuals and movement, the piece shows how those connections flow, overlap and persist beyond geography.
The experience also connected me with many talented and inspiring members of the Sheridan community, which made the process especially meaningful.

body.text: After months of planning, the Women in Business and Technology Club hosted its Training Camp. The event was designed to help students build a strong networking foundation, gain confidence and step outside their comfort zones to connect with professionals in technology and business.
The day featured a series of keynotes, workshops and a panel:

list: Constructing an Elevator Pitch Workshop – Sneha Punwani, MBA
Interview Prep Essentials Presentation – Gloria-anne Walchetseder
Empathy as Your Superpower: Leading with Heart in the Workplace Workshop – Theresa Nguyen
Failing Forward Panel – Hala Anwar and Leigh Mitchell, ChangeMakerCoOrg

title: Speaking at The AI Ladies Lounge

images.alt: Mikaela presenting beside a projected slide titled UX/UI 5 Best Practices.
Mikaela mid-presentation at the front of a lecture room, gesturing toward the audience.
A large group photo of The AI Ladies Lounge attendees in front of floor-to-ceiling windows.
Attendees chatting and networking between presentations.

body.text: I presented on UX/UI best practices at The AI Ladies Lounge, an event led by Maria Becerra. It was my first time speaking to a large audience of new faces, and the room's sharp, thoughtful and welcoming community quickly put me at ease.

The presentations and demos throughout the day gave me a wealth of new practices to apply, and I look forward to bringing these takeaways back to the Women in Business and Technology Club at Sheridan College.
